steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The two main Islamic festivals are Id-ul-Adha (Festival of Sacrifice) and Id-ul-Fitr (Festival of Fast-Breaking). Shi'a Muslims also observe Ashura , commemorating the martyrdom of Imam Husayn. | RS Exam Tips — Islamic Festivals: 1. For Islamic Festivals questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5.
